title: Brand Reputation Pipeline Input
description: Give each brand a name plus one or more platform URLs (Google Maps place, Yelp business, Trustpilot review page, G2 product). The pipeline pulls reviews from each, then returns one cross-platform reputation profile per brand.

brands.title: Brands to profile
brands.description: One object per brand. Each needs a name and at least one platform URL. Fields: name, googlePlaceUrl, googleSearchQuery (used only if googlePlaceUrl is empty), yelpUrl, trustpilotUrl, g2Url. Up to 25 brands per run.

maxReviewsPerPlatform.title: Maximum reviews per platform
maxReviewsPerPlatform.description: Hard cap on reviews pulled from each platform per brand. Higher gives steadier averages and richer themes but raises the per-review charges from the child actors. G2 is additionally capped at 50 by that child.

recentWindowDays.title: Recent window (days)
recentWindowDays.description: Reviews newer than this feed the recent vs overall trend. 90 covers the last quarter.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Passed through to every review child. Residential is recommended; the children fall back to their own defaults if you leave this empty.
